standard-dialogue-before-song-of-the-elv.npc: How do you feel? No heavy flu, shivers, nausea or loss of appetite?
How about nightmares then? Are you experiencing any problems with especially scary nightmares?

standard-dialogue-before-song-of-the-elv.player: No... not since I was young.

standard-dialogue-before-song-of-the-elv.npc: Good, good, I had to make sure. This plague really has an incredibly fast contagion rate. It spreads faster than the common cold!

steps.npc: It came from the west somewhere. It is extremely quick spreading, and utterly deadly.

It varies slightly from case to case, but usually abnormal nightmares and flu-like symptoms, progressing as you succumb more. Eventually, it results in the presence of a thick black tar-like substance secreted
Unfortunately if you reach this stage of infection then no one can save you.
You do that adventurer. You do not want to become infected by the plague.

standard-dialogue-when-speaking-to-docto.npc: Good day, you have my next payment? I don't keep this charade up for fun you know.
Well if you would mention it next time you see the Head Mourner, it would be appreciated.

standard-dialogue-after-song-of-the-elve.npc: Hello there. Can't stop to talk I'm afraid, I'm very busy right now.
